rules.description: An application is treated as a renewal when the student continues with the same scholarship scheme in the same institute or school.
rules.condition: The student continues with the same scheme (Pre Matric, Post Matric or Merit cum Means) in the same Institute/School.
rules.outcome: The application will be considered as a renewal of application.
rules.evidence_quote: All such applications where a student continues with the same scheme (Pre Matric, Post Matric and Merit cum Means scholarship schemes) in the same Institute/School will be considered as renewal of application.

rules.description: Renewal applicants only need to express interest and update minimal details in the existing application form.
rules.condition: The student is applying for renewal and the system already has information from the previous academic year.
rules.outcome: The student has to only update minimal details in the existing application form.
rules.evidence_quote: To do so, students have to only update minimal details in the existing application form.

rules.description: Renewal applicants are subject to a simplified verification process because they were already verified in the previous academic session.
rules.condition: The student is a renewal applicant who was verified during the previous academic session.
rules.outcome: The verification process for renewal students is quite simple.
rules.evidence_quote: Even the verification process for Renewal students is quite simple as they have already been verified during the previous academic session.

rules.description: Renewal applications must be submitted within the specified application window.
rules.condition: The application is being submitted for renewal in the year 2017.
rules.outcome: The application must be filed between 1st June and 31st July, 2017.
